title: Move process
dateHintInterview: Leave it blank if you do not know it yet. If you do not know the time, it stays at 14:00; clear it and it counts as all day.
dateHintTest: Leave it blank if there is no date. If you do not know the time, it stays at 14:00; clear it and it counts as all day.

noMove.cvReady: A job reaches “CV ready” when its CV is verified (with “Generate CV”), not by hand.
noMove.approved: To go back to “Approved” you have to reopen it from its detail page.
noMove.reopenTo: Reopening it takes it back to “{{stage}}”.
noMove.cannotReopen: This job cannot be reopened from the board.
noMove.noEvent: From “{{from}}” there is no event that takes it to “{{to}}”.

conflict.title: Something is logged after that date
conflict.intro: To log “{{event}}” on {{when}}, this cannot come after it:
conflict.removeHint: If you logged it by mistake, remove it and the event is logged on the date you chose.
conflict.cannotRemove: This cannot be removed from here: interviews and tests are deleted from their own card, and a received or accepted offer cannot be removed.
conflict.laterHint: Or log it right after, even if it is not the exact date:
conflict.noLater: Pick a date after the items in the list.
